nl.title: Wat is bandbreedte of dataverkeer?
nl.excerpt: Wat bandbreedte/dataverkeer is en hoe je het in DirectAdmin afleest.
nl.bodyHtml:
Bandbreedte is maandelijkse traffic. Pieken komen door downloads, bots of hotlinking.

Voorbereiding

  • Usage/stats toegang

Stappen

  1. Bekijk bandwidth usage in Account Manager / stats
  2. Identificeer pieken (logs/AWStats indien aanwezig)
  3. Optimaliseer zware files/CDN
  4. Blokkeer misbruikende IP’s indien nodig

Controleren

  • Begrip van verbruik vs. limiet

Tip: CDN verlaagt origin-traffic.

Let op: Overschrijding kan throttle/suspend veroorzaken volgens package.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: usage-warning; ext-hoe-blokkeer-ik-een-ip-adres-in-directadmin.

en.title: What is bandwidth or data traffic?
en.excerpt: Files in DirectAdmin File Manager: correct folder, permissions, .htaccess; check disk/inodes.
en.bodyHtml:
“What is bandwidth or data traffic”: work in DirectAdmin → File Manager in the correct user/domain path (often domains/…/public_html).

Preparation

  • DirectAdmin login
  • Path to the site
  • Backup for .htaccess/permissions

Steps

  1. Sign in to DirectAdmin → System Info & Files → File Manager.
  2. Navigate to domains/yourdomain/public_html (or the intended subdirectory).
  3. For .htaccess/security: edit or create .htaccess; for folder passwords use Password Protected Directories.
  4. Keep permissions conservative (files ~644, folders ~755) — not 777.
  5. If disk/inodes are full: remove caches, old backups and large logs; empty File Manager Trash.
  6. Test the URL in a private window.

Verify

  • Site/folder behaves as intended
  • No 500 from a broken .htaccess

Tip: Download a copy of .htaccess before experimenting.

Note: Do not delete wp-config or .env ‘to free space’.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: FTP/SFTP, backups, PHP errors.
